criteria.rationale: Born June 26, 1984, the patient was 42 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the prescribing note proposes Wegovy for excess weight after a minimal response to lifestyle measures.
Within 180 days of the request, the notes document continued adherence to the reduced-calorie meal plan and lunchtime walking. The prescribing plan says to continue diet and walking with Wegovy.

The structured program began in November 2025 and was documented as continuing through August 8, 2026—more than six whole calendar months. Notes document a reduced-calorie plan, walking, and ongoing coaching and follow-up without a recorded interruption.

The latest structured BMI before the request is 26.6, below both the 30 threshold and the 27 threshold applicable with a documented weight-related comorbidity. Hypertension is documented but does not overcome the BMI shortfall.

missing_requirements: Baseline BMI of at least 30, or at least 27 with a documented weight-related comorbidity.
